s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly progressive visual impairment with endocrine dysfunction
salient_findings: Sellar/suprasellar mass compressing the optic chiasm
key_facts: 2-week history of rapidly progressive visual reduction
Vestibular schwannoma treated by gamma-knife radiosurgery 2 years earlier
Mass compressing the optic chiasm and extending toward the left cavernous sinus
Lesion predominantly isointense to gray matter on T1-weighted images
Diffuse homogeneous enhancement after contrast administration
Normal pituitary gland on MRI 2 years earlier
